calls.bash: for w in w1 w2 w3; do mu agent spawn $w -w eval --workspace >/dev/null 2>&1; done; mu agent list -w eval
mu task claim a1 -w eval --for w1; mu task claim a2 -w eval --for w2; mu task claim a3 -w eval --for w3
for p in 'w1 a1' 'w2 a2' 'w3 a3'; do set -- $p; mu agent send $1 -w eval "do $2 and close it"; done
mu agent wait w1 w2 w3 -w eval --after-runs 0 --timeout 120 --json

mu task release a1 -w eval && mu agent spawn w4 -w eval --workspace && mu task claim a1 -w eval --for w4 && mu agent send w4 -w eval 'do a1 and close it' && mu agent send w2 -w eval 'carry on with a2 and close it'
mu task wait a1 a2 a3 -w eval --timeout 120
for w in w4 w2 w3; do git cherry-pick $(git -C $(mu workspace path $w -w eval) rev-parse HEAD) || exit 1; done; mu agent close -w eval w1 --discard-workspace

text: a1, a2 and a3 are done and merged into main.
